name: 94404 · Foster City, CA
findings: ZIP 94404 (Foster City) has 199 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94404 (Foster City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 42 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
